entries.pending: re-bless: F-v2-1 (steep heads of filled-outline curves traced to the top frame)
entries.why: Rule-4 sweep of batch_all_v3: FDP8870's curves are filled outlines whose steep heads the column sampler served as a few mid-run points; the source outlines run to the top frame (source top y=49 px, plot y0=49). F-v2-1 adds the head row by row on each curve's own outline (row_traced_points_px). No golden point moved or was removed; no readout, label, temperature, I_D value, status or validation changed. The I_D binding provenance changed with the traced heads: 'ID = 35A' now sits nearest its own head (proximity_far_curve_behind_near_curve) and 'ID = 1A' follows by elimination -- the frozen fixture had both by id_order_rule; the values (1 A on c0, 35 A on c1) are the same.
